reviews.text: The best vet in Miami!!! They truly care about there clients and go above and beyond to make sure your pets stay healthy!!

I have been bringing my dogs here for a few years now and they have always been excellent. The staff is friendly and professional, and they always treat my pups with the utmost care. I always recommend them!
Excellent service personnel, excellent doctor, I am very satisfied.

These people gave me the medicine that suffocated my cat, when I expressed frustration that they didn’t make more of an effort to reach out to me they dropped me as a patient, sent me graphic pictures of my cat’s autopsied dead body because the doctor refused to just tell me the results aaand they kept my money for an old credit and refused to issue payment for 3 years 😐

Also when I was there, a Good Samaritan stopped by with an injured kitten that he found and they were extremely rude to the poor guy and basically looked at the dying injured animal as a transaction, it was years ago but I remember he told the story and it was basically “okay and? Do you have a credit card”
Absolutely incredible Vet clinic. They treat your animals as if they were their own.
Was grateful to have this team help my senior kitty towards the end of her life. Highly recommend!
Very professional and caring! Dr.Dixon is a cat whisperer!

The doctors here are amazing but the front desk people suck. I have a 5 year old dog that’s losing weight, peeing in his sleep and the vet was super concerned about. I’ve spent a few thousand dollars there the past week without issue. The doctor calls yesterday to say someone will reach out to schedule an ultrasound, never hear anything. I call to schedule and it’s met with “ma’am i wasn’t here yesterday it’s not my fault now we can’t do anything until Monday” then I can’t schedule anything without a credit card (mind you I’ve just spent thousands there without issue), as I’m literally outside with my dog who needs to use the bathroom every hour. From someone that owns multiple medical offices, gross
